description: Welcome to Team Vidyadarma! 🚀 I have strong backgrounds in AI, React, Unity game dev, and educational mentoring. We are building an interactive, AI-powered 'Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer' to make space learning fun for kids.
summary:
Astro-Gotchi: Mars Outpost Survival is an educational web-based simulation created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer), designed to teach children aged 7 to 12 the critical realities of space exploration. Players step into the role of a Junior Outpost Commander who must keep Commander Leo alive across seven Martian Sols to earn official NASA Junior Astronaut Certification.

Unlike traditional virtual pets, the game centers on realistic survival trade-offs, requiring players to balance electrical power, MOXIE-generated oxygen, and crew health against authentic space hazards derived from real NASA DONKI space weather and OSDR space biology data. Featuring an interactive 3D habitat with low-gravity physics, daily shift allocations, and a companion AI assistant named A.N.I.S., Astro-Gotchi delivers a fast, zero-install educational adventure where every decision carries meaningful scientific consequences
details: Astro-Gotchi: Mars Outpost Survival is an educational, browser-based space mission trainer created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge (Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer) that teaches children aged 7 to 12 the critical realities of spaceflight through the lens of strategic survival trade-offs. Assuming the role of a Junior Outpost Commander at Jezero Crater, players must guide astronaut Commander Leo through seven Martian Sols to earn their official NASA Junior Astronaut Certification by balancing three interconnected lifelines—power, MOXIE-generated oxygen, and crew health—against genuine space hazards derived from authentic NASA DONKI space weather alerts, NASA OSDR space biology data, and NASA Mars Trek cartography. Merging a nostalgic Vault-Tec retro-futuristic aesthetic with an interactive Three.js 3D habitat featuring 0.38g low-gravity parabolic jumps, a daily three-shift maintenance system, a guided hands-on practice tutorial, and a Google Gemini-powered companion AI named A.N.I.S., this lightweight, zero-install React application bridges rigorous aerospace science and playful storytelling to inspire the Artemis generation with accessible, critical-thinking STEM education.
